title: Membership in the free coordinate set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, and let $i$ be a coordinate. Then $i$ belongs to the set of free coordinates of $\rho$ if and only if $\rho(i)$ is free.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns a restriction state to each coordinate
